title: Olive and the Big Barn
checkpoint: Year 1 Spring 1, week 1 — School readiness — Phase 5: new ways to say and spell y, y, a, e
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — review of split digraphs and early alternative pronunciations.

pages.text: Olive and Fig go into the big barn.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl and Fig the caterpillar stepping together into a dim, dusty old barn, sunlight cutting through gaps in the wood.

pages.text: Olive spots a nest high up.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl looking up at a small nest tucked into the barn rafters.

pages.text: Olive stops to look at the nest.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl standing still, gazing up at the nest, while Fig keeps walking ahead unseen.

pages.text: Fig creeps on and out of sight.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar moving further into the barn, with Olive now alone, out of sight.

pages.text: Olive looks round. Fig is not there.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl turning her head, looking around an empty patch of the barn, no sign of Fig.
Olive the owl calling out loudly, beak open, inside the shadowy barn.

pages.text: Fig hears the call and stops.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar pausing mid-step, antennae lifted, listening to a distant call.

pages.text: Fig creeps back to look for Olive.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar moving back the way it came through the barn.

pages.text: Fig spots Olive by the nest.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar arriving beside Olive the owl, who is still standing under the rafters.

pages.text: Olive grins. "I am glad you came back."
pages.illustration: Olive the owl and Fig the caterpillar standing together happily, the nest visible above them.
